description: Continuous minimum-separation rule |s_candidate - s_bound| < exclusionDistance on the filament-GLOBAL material coordinate, comparing a candidate against every already-bound head on the SAME filament (GLOBAL rule). Ported from the sister-head-only diagnostic veto into the canonical explicit-S2 single-head gliding path (CPU + GPU) and the CPU HMM-dimer path.
exclusion_provenance: experimental continuous steric-separation rule from the existing diagnostic ExplicitHmmDimer3jsHarness.STANDING_EXCLUSION_NM (~one actin-monomer axial spacing). NOT a claim of biological truth.
boundary_convention: reject iff separation < exclusion - tol (tol = 1e-3 nm); exactly 5.4 nm is ALLOWED
same_step_conflict_rule: deterministic sequential accept in ascending head-id order; lowest head-id wins; each accepted head becomes occupied for later same-step candidates; no RNG / no lottery
sister_head_semantics: INCLUDED in the global rule (a bound sister is just a bound head on the same filament). This DIFFERS from the pre-existing sister-only veto (global superset-of sister); the sister-only veto is preserved unchanged as the named regression path.

flags.single_head: -occupancy-exclusion-nm <nm>  (0 or omitted = OFF = exact canonical path)

canonical_invariants_unchanged.STANDING_EXCLUSION_NM: untouched (5.4 nm; the diagnostic sister-only constant reused as the study value)

off_path_identity: byte/event-identical: the OFF single-head production cell PARTCROW is bit-identical to the git-HEAD baseline; the resolve(exclusion=0) pipeline reproduces canonical matBindExplicit binding decisions bit-identically over a 600-step trajectory

kernels.matBindGateOnly: parallel gate-only twin of matBindExplicit (writes candidate scratch, defers commit)
kernels.matOccupancyResolve: single-thread serial commit with global exclusion + lowest-id same-step conflict resolution
kernels.computeMaterialMaps: host precompute of segCumArc (cumulative arc, um) + segFilId (connected-component filament id)

cpu_gpu_equivalence: deterministic resolve kernel bit-identical CPU<->GPU on a constructed fixture (2 rejects incl 1 same-step conflict, 2 accepts; boundSeg + occStats 0 mismatches); real-pipeline binding events bit-identical CPU<->GPU while the microstate is bit-close (occStat divergences 0), then chaotic float32 decorrelation (expected, not tested)
deferred: dimer GPU kernel (later task, if warranted)

softbox/ExplicitHmmDimerGlidingHarness.java (-occupancy-global GLOBAL rule; sister-only preserved as regression)

experiment.path: single-head explicit-s2-l40, GPU device-resident, rigor mode 1, dt 2.5e-6, whole-window LS velocity
experiment.note: 5-density PAIRED diagnostic, NOT a replacement canonical sweep; any Vmax/rho_half fit is diagnostic-only

result.decision_label: No measurable effect (numerically active, behaviorally inert)
result.interpretation: Continuous 5.4 nm exclusion fires hard at high density (38% rejection at rho3000) but does not cap recruitment or change velocity/saturation, because the filament is far from 5.4-nm-saturated (~100 nm mean head spacing >> 5.4 nm). Informative null; not tuned away.
result.smallest_next_step: exclusion-DISTANCE sweep {5.4,11,22,36} nm at rho in {1500,3000}; NOT a discrete-site/13-6 lattice
